chunks: If the slave becomes blind, then he is emancipated.

key_terms.اَلصَّادِقُ: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq عليه السلام, the authority transmitting this ruling

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a slave becomes blind in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling from Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام concerning the emancipation of a slave who becomes blind. It indicates that blindness is a cause for the slave's freedom in this juristic context.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3518 - Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"If a slave becomes blind, he is emancipated."
